ui_shell.name: Campaign HUD layout
ui_shell.description: Classic keeps the multi-bar campaign interface. New shell enables the corner plate, ruled date journal, unified alert column and compact map bar live without restarting.

ui_shell_next_hints.name: Early-game "Next" guidance
ui_shell_next_hints.description: Shows one soft "Next" direction row at the bottom of the alert column during the opening two months of a campaign.

ui_shell_minimap.name: Corner minimap in new shell
ui_shell_minimap.description: Adds a compact minimap preview above the bottom-right map bar in the new campaign shell.

ui_shell_message_preset.name: Campaign message density
ui_shell_message_preset.description: Controls which campaign events pause the clock, show a newspaper card, add an alert row, or stay in the news log.
